$comment: THE VERSION OF EACH PUBLISHED ARTIFACT -- EDIT ONLY WITH `node tools/artifact_versions.mjs bump` (CR-820).

A version is the UTC time its inputs last changed, written here and committed, so the same commit always builds the same bytes and a commit that touches none of the inputs (a docs-only commit) changes neither the version nor the bytes. The build never asks git for it: the Pages checkout is shallow.
grsRelay: grs-relay.mcpb, grs-relay.mjs and the relay's serverInfo (semver YEAR.MMDD.HHMMSS, docs/spec/_assets/design-mcp-relay.md section 6). The download page shows the same time.
serverSyncDemo: grs-server-sync-demo.zip; every entry carries this time, so the zip is byte-reproducible.
node tools/artifact_versions.mjs check (check.sh) is red when an input changed after the line holding the artifact's BuiltAt last changed.
